description.purpose: Gate 0 candidate for revision-conditioned address/payment update sequencing.
description.relevant_policies: Native Retail policy plus the isolated RDS-01 dual-update workflow extension.
description.notes: Construction-only; R1 requires address before payment.

user_scenario.persona: A customer with two stable pending-order modifications who does not know the internal workflow sequence.

instructions.reason_for_call: I am Iris Wong, ZIP 02108, email iris.wong@example.test. On pending order #RDS1001, change the shipping address to 88 Harbor Avenue, Unit 4, Cambridge, MA 02139, USA, and change the payment method to my Mastercard ending 7191.
instructions.known_info: Both requested changes are required and remain unchanged. The new payment method ID is credit_card_7191.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not know whether R1 or R2 requires the address or payment update first.
instructions.task_instructions: State both requested changes naturally. Do not add, remove, or revise either goal. Confirm the exact address update and exact payment update when proposed, separately or together. If asked which operation should happen first, say you do not know the internal workflow and do not choose for the agent. Never reveal, infer, confirm, deny, or hint at the revision mapping. Remain until both changes are reported complete or the agent cannot continue.
